jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to provide high-level support to the Director General. This is a key position requiring exceptional organisational skills, professionalism, discretion, and the ability to operate confidently in a fast-paced international environment.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established European association based in Brussels, representing and supporting members across Europe. Operating in an international and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in fostering collaboration, advocacy, and knowledge sharing within its sector.

Description

• Act as the trusted right hand and strategic support to the Director General
• Manage a complex agenda, shifting priorities, and high-level executive commitments
• Coordinate international travel, itineraries, and meeting preparations
• Monitor and manage the Director General's inbox, correspondence, and follow-ups
• Prepare presentations, briefing documents, reports, and executive materials
• Ensure action points are tracked and deadlines are met across multiple projects
• Organise and coordinate Board Meetings, General Assemblies, and leadership meetings
• Take meeting minutes and follow up on agreed actions
• Build strong relationships with members, partners, and key stakeholders across Europe
• Liaise with internal teams to ensure smooth communication and coordination
• Handle sensitive and confidential information with the highest level of discretion
• Maintain accurate records, databases, and executive documentation
• Review expenses, approvals, and administrative processes
• Act as a key point of contact on behalf of the Director General when required
• Support the smooth functioning of the executive office and provide back-up within the administrative team
• Anticipate needs, solve problems proactively, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
 

• 15 to 20 years of experience in a similar Executive Assistant role
• Previous experience supporting C-level or Executive-level leadership
• Experience within an international organisation, association, federation, or EU environment is highly desirable
• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
• Excellent command of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook)
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills
• Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented mindset
• Highly professional, trustworthy, and discreet
• Eager to learn and continuously improve

Our client is an engineering company.

Jobomschrijving

1. IT Infrastructure Governance & Strategy

• Assess business and end-user needs, as well as quality, operational, and security requirements.
• Translate business requirements into IT solutions and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
• Design, maintain, and continuously improve the local IT infrastructure architecture in alignment with business objectives and Group standards.
• Advise management on IT strategy, technology evolution, infrastructure investments, and risk mitigation.
• Monitor emerging technologies and recommend improvements to systems, services, and operational efficiency.
• Ensure compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, licensing, and corporate requirements.

2. User Support & Service Delivery

• Provide technical support to end-users through telephone, e-mail, remote assistance, and face-to-face interventions.
• Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and system-related issues.
• Assist end-users in the effective use of IT equipment, systems, and applications.
• Deliver user guidance and training when required.
• Coordinate with external providers and Group IT teams to ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
• Coordinate with external providers and Group IT teams to ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
• Document support procedures and maintain an up-to-date knowledge base.

3. Infrastructure Operations & Maintenance

• Design, implement, operate, and maintain local IT infrastructure including servers, networks, endpoints, and associated services.
• Ensure the availability, reliability, and performance of IT systems and infrastructure.
• Manage backup, recovery, monitoring, and business continuity mechanisms.
• Perform infrastructure updates, upgrades, patch management, and corrective maintenance activities.
• Maintain accurate technical documentation, inventory records, system configurations, and operational procedures.
• Ensure the smooth operation of all IT services, including network services, endpoint management, printing services, e-mail systems, and security tools.

4. Cybersecurity & Compliance

• Support the development, implementation, maintenance, and monitoring of the cybersecurity policies, procedures, and controls in accordance with legal, regulatory, customer, and Group requirements.
• Continuously assess and improve the security posture of systems, applications, and infrastructure.
• Ensure the effective operation of security solutions, including endpoint protection, access control, monitoring, backup, and recovery systems.
• Contribute to security audits, compliance assessments, and corrective action plans.
• Participate in the management of cybersecurity incidents and crisis situations involving complex infrastructure or software issues.

• A bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
• A minimum of five years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or a comparable role.
• Strong hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Windows environments, Microsoft 365, Active Directory or Entra ID, networking, endpoint management, backup and recovery, virtualization, and infrastructure monitoring.
• Practical knowledge of cybersecurity controls, vulnerability and patch management, access control, endpoint protection, incident response, and secure infrastructure configuration.
• Experience providing remote and on-site end-user support and managing incidents, service requests, technical documentation, and SLAs.
• Experience managing IT suppliers, licenses, assets, procurement activities, and budget-related processes.
• Experience with ISO 27001 implementation is a strong plus.
• Proven ability to operate independently as a local IT point of contact while collaborating effectively with centralised Group IT functions.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, stakeholder-management, and organisational skills.
• Professional fluency in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an advantage.
• Willingness to participate in an on-call rota and provide support outside standard working hours when required.
• Relevant Microsoft, networking, ITIL, or cybersecurity certifications are considered an advantage.

Our client is a globally renowned law firm with an outstanding reputation across the UK, the US, and international markets. With offices located worldwide, the firm advises leading multinational organizations on complex legal matters across various industries.

Due to continued growth of the Brussels office and an upcoming move to larger premises early next year, the firm is looking to strengthen its support team with an additional Legal Assistant. You will join a collaborative environment and work closely with another experienced Legal Assistant in a duo setup, ensuring seamless support to the legal team.

Jobomschrijving

This position is primarily focused on legal administration and billing support (approximately 90% of the role), with a smaller reception component (approximately 10%).

Legal & Administrative Support

• Manage complex billing processes and prepare client invoices with a high level of accuracy.
• Follow up on billing queries and liaise with lawyers and finance teams when needed.
• Prepare, format, proofread, and finalize legal documents, presentations, and correspondence.
• Manage agendas, schedule meetings, and coordinate appointments.
• Organize travel arrangements and business itineraries.
• Handle document management and maintain electronic filing systems.
• Open new client matters and support conflict check processes.
• Monitor deadlines and assist lawyers with day-to-day administrative requirements.
• Provide support to a Partner, two Counsel, and several Associates within the Antitrust practice.

Reception Support (10%)

• Welcome visitors and clients in a professional and courteous manner.
• Answer and redirect incoming calls when required.
• Support the office with occasional front-desk coverage alongside the wider administrative team.

• Previous experience as a Legal Assistant, Practice Assistant, Legal Secretary, or similar support position within a law firm is essential.
• Proven experience managing legal billing and invoicing processes.
• Strong administrative and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
• Near-native level of English is mandatory.
• Good working knowledge of either French or Dutch (minimum B1 level).
• Comfortable supporting senior legal professionals in a demanding international environment.
• Proactive, resourceful, and capable of anticipating needs before they arise.
• Professional, discreet, and confident in managing confidential information.
• Team-oriented mindset with the ability to work closely in partnership with another Legal Assistant.

Candidates must already be based in Belgium and have the right to work in Belgium. Visa sponsorship cannot be provided for this position.

About the company:

Our client, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company introducing innovative CAR-T cell therapy. Their team is making a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a strong growth phase and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading biotechnology company, is looking for individuals interested in joining their team as a Support Operator/Laboratory Disinfection Specialist.

Before you join their professional team, you will receive thorough training in aseptic (germ-free) work, GMP, and related procedures. As a support operator, you will be responsible for maintaining the assigned areas and production zones in the laboratory in spotless condition. With the utmost precision, you will ensure the maintenance of equipment used, and the cleanliness and disinfection of materials. You will handle cleaning agents and materials safely and correctly. The laboratory works with biological products in a strictly controlled environment where your attention to detail can impact human lives.

 

Step into the world of biotechnology and become part of a dynamic team!

Profile:

• Cleanliness and order are very important to you.

• Experience in a sterile environment is a plus.

• You are enthusiastic about teamwork and can work well both independently and in a group.

• You are highly proficient in English.

• You have at least basic knowledge of MS Office (as a large part of the job involves recording, reporting, and online training).

• Wearing a sterile suit and strictly following procedures is no problem for you.

About the Company:

Our client is a respected organization where quality, safety, and teamwork are core values. As a VCA**-certified company, they are committed to providing excellent service to their clients while fostering a growth-oriented and supportive environment for their employees. They are looking for individuals who share their passion for excellence and innovation.

Jobomschrijving

At our client’s company, quality and safety are at the heart of everything they do (VCA**-certified). Equally important, however, are their people. Due to their continued growth, they are looking for a motivated Industrial Electrician to make a real difference within their organization.

Your Role:
	
• Perform on-site interventions at the client’s location in case of issues.	
• Take responsibility for repairing reported problems at the client’s site.	
• Verify that the actions taken result in the optimal functioning of the equipment.	
• Ensure all work is delivered with a focus on safety, efficiency, quality, and timing.	
• Act as the main point of contact for the client on-site and provide internal reports to the project manager.	
• Collaborate effectively, whether working independently or as part of a team.

Profile Description: 

A technical education in an electrical field (or equivalent through experience).

Strong communication skills in Dutch or English.

A customer-friendly attitude: You prioritize client values and ensure commitments are met.

A flexible mindset: You adapt your approach as needed to achieve goals and handle changes effectively.

A valid driver’s license (Category B).

VCA and BA4/5 certifications are a plus, but not mandatory.

Onze klant, een biotech bedrijf, gevestigd in Zwijnaarde, is een wereldwijd biotechnologiebedrijf dat de innovatieve CAR-T celtheraptie naar Gent brengt. Het bedrijf maakt hiermee dagdagelijks het verschil in het leven van vele patiënten die lijden aan kanker en andere levensbedreigende ziektes.
Ze zijn momenteel in een fase van sterke groei en zoeken gemotiveerde en toegewijde teamleden. 

Jobomschrijving

We’re looking for skilled individuals to join our mission of transforming medicine. This is more than just a job—it’s an opportunity to advance your career in a dynamic, purpose-driven environment. Whether you have a secondary education with hands-on experience or are a recent graduate with a bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related fields—and especially if you’ve worked in cleanrooms, pharmaceutical manufacturing, or chemical processing—we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for dedicated process operators to join our team at a leading biotechnology company. What can you expect in this exciting role?

Your journey begins with extensive training, where we immerse you in the world of aseptic (germ-free) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) operations, including the crucial procedures you need to master.

Afterward, you will join our dynamic and driven Operations team, which works together every day to fulfill our mission. Alongside your fellow operators and team leaders, you will perform aseptic and manual production processes according to strict, proven procedures.

Daily aseptic and manual production processes

Working in a cleanroom lab environment

Executing production steps in controlled environments (grade A/B/C/D) such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products.

Managing equipment: inspections and maintenance

Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials

Supporting transitions between production zones

Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

A strong sense of responsibility and passion to make a difference in the lives of patients.

Clear verbal and written communication skills with an attention to detail and the ability to follow procedures.

You thrive in fast-paced environments and are eager to learn and grow in advanced biomanufacturing.

You like structure and order, are very accurate and are willing to work in an aseptic environment with appropriate sterile clothing.

You have a relevant 'graduaat' or a bachelor’s degree. Alternatively, if you hold a secondary education diploma and have initial experience in a lab or cleanroom or hospital environment, pharmaceutical manufacturing, chemical processing, or similar regulated industries you are also eligible.

You are willing to work in a shift regime 4 days of working 4 days.

You speak very good English.

You’re excited to work with cutting-edge equipment and technologies

Company’s activities can be divided into 6 units: BUILDINGS; PARKINGS & TUNNELS, SERVICE & MAINTENANCE; INDUSTRIAL VENTILATION; PARKING GUIDANCE; DAYLIGHT & SUN PROTECTION. 

Their service & maintenance department ensures that all SHEV systems and their possible fire and gas detection, extinguishers, fire hoses, emergency lighting, emergency power generators receive the necessary check-ups after installation and that they can be repaired if necessary.

Jobomschrijving

As a Fitter, you will be responsible for a comprehensive set of tasks:

As a service fitter, you will be tasked with installing smoke exhaust systems and smoke curtains for professional clients in various settings including tunnels, industrial buildings, parking lots, and shopping centers. Your workplace will consistently vary, offering extensive challenges and much variety in your role!

Profile Description
	
• Technical Background: You hold a technical diploma in electromechanics or equivalent through experience.	
• Electrical Knowledge: You possess a solid general knowledge of electricity.	
• Physical Condition: You are physically fit for labor-intensive work and do not have a fear of heights, as the job is primarily on flat roofs, making this an important point.	
• Independent and Team-oriented: You are capable of working independently and enjoy working in a small team.	
• Language Proficiency: You can communicate well in Dutch or French or Englisch. 	
• License: You hold a valid Class B driver’s license.
Certification: Possession of a VCA certificate is a definite advantage

Company Activities

Our client is a leader in the travel bag, luggage, and accessories industry, known for combining style with cutting-edge design technology and a commitment to quality and durability. With over a century of heritage, they offer unparalleled products that meet the needs of travelers worldwide. Their brands are sold in over 100 countries, providing a diverse and inclusive work environment that values sustainability and innovation.

 

Jobomschrijving

Are you ready to take your career to the next level as a Mold Technician? Our client is seeking a skilled and motivated individual to join their team in Oudenaarde. As a Mold Technician, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation and maintenance of molds used in production.

Key Responsibilities:
	
• Independently assemble, disassemble, and maintain molds to ensure they are production-ready.	
• Repair hydraulic cylinders and create flexible hoses for hydraulic and gas applications.	
• Conduct fine mechanical work and apply simple sandblast structures.	
• Diagnose and propose technical improvements for defective molds.	
• Occasionally engage in turning, milling, and grinding tasks with training provided when necessary.

Profile Description

The ideal candidate for the Mold Technician role possesses:
	
• A Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics or an A2 in mechanics with a minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar position.	
• Experience in a production environment, especially in machining operations such as turning, grinding, and milling.	
• Strong technical insight and a passion for mechanics.	
• Basic knowledge of electricity.	
• Resilience under pressure and willingness to work in a two-shift system after the training period.	
• Good knowledge of English or Dutch.

About the Company:

Our client, headquartered in Zwijnaarde, is a leading global biotechnology company introducing groundbreaking cell therapy to Ghent. Their dedicated team plays a crucial role in improving the lives of patients battling cancer and other severe illnesses. As they continue to grow, they are looking for motivated and committed individuals to join their dynamic workforce.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, an innovative and rapidly expanding biotech company, we are currently seeking a Warehouse Associate.

Responsibilities:

As a Warehouse Associate, you will be responsible for:
	
• Handling biohazard materials such as blood bags and viral vectors in a temperature-controlled environment.	
• Accurately processing incoming inventory by verifying purchase orders, conducting quality checks, and ensuring compliance with company policies.	
• Managing equipment and materials stored at cryogenic temperatures.	
• Completing Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for received goods, including transportation inspections, temperature control, integrity verification, and proper documentation.	
• Filling in necessary forms and logbooks related to receiving, picking, and outbound operations in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP).	
• Collaborating closely with the Operations and Quality departments to facilitate production and laboratory activities at the start-up site.	
• Working in a sterile environment while wearing specialized protective clothing.	
• Using two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to manage inbound, picking, and outbound logistics.	
• Coordinating with accounting, suppliers, and business stakeholders to enhance operational efficiency.

Candidate Profile:
	
• High school diploma or associate’s degree.	
• Prior warehouse experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.	
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to complete administrative tasks such as filling out forms and maintaining logbooks.	
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across various levels of the organization.	
• Problem-solving mindset with solid analytical and data interpretation skills.	
• Strict adherence to protocols to ensure product quality and personal safety at all times.	
• Ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of responsibility.	
• Proficiency in English is essential.

jobs.occupation: Legal & Operation Officer - Private Clients - Flemish Brabant
jobs.description:
Our client is a highly respected Belgian boutique advisory firm founded by two former lawyers from leading international law firms. The organization supports high-profile prestigious clients and their families throughout every stage of their personal and professional journey.

Combining legal expertise, wealth structuring coordination, contract advisory, estate planning support, tax coordination, and day-to-day administrative assistance, the firm delivers a unique and highly personalized service to a portfolio of more than 100 clients across Belgium and internationally.

With a close-knit team of around 10-15 professionals, the company offers an entrepreneurial environment where quality, trust, and excellence are at the heart of everything they do.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Counsel your responsibilities are:

• Advise and assist clients on a wide range of legal matters.
• Review, draft, and coordinate contractual documentation.
• Support matters relating to estate planning, wealth structuring, insurance, and family law.
• Coordinate real estate transactions, including purchase agreements, leases, and notarial processes.
• Liaise with external advisors including notaries, tax experts, accountants, and legal counsel.
• Provide practical support regarding social security, invoicing, and administrative matters.
• Organize and structure client files while ensuring excellent follow-up.
• Monitor deadlines, legal documentation, and ongoing projects.
• Deliver pragmatic and solutions-oriented legal guidance.
• Communicate legal concepts in a simple and accessible manner.

A successful Legal Counsel should have:

• Belgian Master's degree in Law 
• Legal professional as from 3 years of experience are welcome to apply.
• Strong analytical skills and legal reasoning.
• Excellent organizational and planning abilities.
• Detail-oriented, critical thinker, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Fluent in Dutch & English
• Proactive and hands-on personality.
• Mature enough to work autonomously while knowing when to seek guidance.
• Genuine willingness to learn and develop.
• Comfortable working in an environment where responsibility comes early.

An SME in the Waasland region known for the production, purchase, and sale of pallets.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:
Are you seeking a new challenge where you can utilize your physical strength and precision? Our client, a renowned company in pallet production, is looking for a Robot Operator for Pallet Production.

As a Robot Operator for Pallet Production, you will be responsible for operating the production robot. Your role includes preparing the workstation: arranging planks and components on the worktable, which are then automatically assembled by the robot. The job requires physical effort, is repetitive in nature, and takes place in a noisy environment. Therefore, we are looking for someone who is up for the challenge.

Your tasks include:
	
• Preparing and placing planks and components on the worktable.	
• Operating and monitoring the production robot.	
• Ensuring a safe and efficient work environment.	
• Collaborating with the team to ensure smooth production processes.

Profile Description
What are we looking for?

We are seeking an energetic and physically strong individual who meets the following requirements:
	
• You are physically fit and comfortable with repetitive tasks.	
• You are flexible: until September, you will work in a day shift, and afterward in a two-shift system (morning and afternoon shifts).	
• You can communicate in Dutch or English to collaborate effectively with the team.	
• You work accurately and have attention to detail.	
• You have prior experience in a production environment.

Our client is a well-established manufacturing company based in Drongen, specializing in the production of high-quality coffins. To strengthen their production team, they are looking for a motivated Machine Operator (CNC Milling Machine) to join their permanent night shift.

Jobomschrijving

Your Responsibilities
	
• Operate a CNC milling/routing machine.	
• Monitor the production process and ensure smooth machine operation.	
• Perform quality checks on finished products.	
• Maintain a safe and organized work environment.	
• Assist with material handling when required.

Your Profile
	
• Experience operating CNC machinery is an advantage.	
• Forklift experience or a valid forklift certificate is considered a strong plus.	
• You are willing to complete a training period of approximately 3 months in either the early or late shift before transitioning to the permanent night shift.	
• You can communicate effectively in Dutch, English, or French.	
• You are detail-oriented and committed to quality.	
• You are reliable and comfortable working in a production environment.

Company

Founded in Belgium in 1935, our client has grown into an international leader in sustainable packaging solutions. Their packaging—from corrugated cardboard and solid board to tubes and protective corners—is produced with recycled paper and is 100% recyclable and biodegradable. With a long-term vision and focus on sustainability, they combine ecological and economic progress. Their products, relationships, and management style all contribute to a greener planet. Today, our client has 6,500 employees, spread across 70 locations in 21 countries. The headquarters is located in Aalst.

Jobomschrijving

For the location in Hoogstraten, our client is looking for enthusiastic operators.

Curious about how paper and cardboard are made? With our client, you will learn it all!

As an operator, you play a crucial role in the production process. These are your responsibilities:
	
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring machines for the production of paper and cardboard products.	
• Starting and stopping machines according to prescribed procedures.	
• Performing quality checks on products during the production process.	
• Ensuring a smooth production process with your colleagues.	
• Performing first-line maintenance on the machines.	
• Reporting technical malfunctions and working with the technical department to resolve them.
Monitoring the safety instructions and ensuring they are applied in the workplace

Eager to learn and interested in growth opportunities? Then you are the operator our client is looking for!
	
• Working in a production environment doesn’t scare you, even if it’s noisy.	
• You are a handy person with an interest in technology.	
• You value safety, order, cleanliness, and quality.	
• You are open to feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.	
• You demonstrate responsibility and are always ready to help others.	
• You have basic PC skills.	
• You will be employed in a 2-shift or 5-shift system.	
• You speak good Dutch or English.

Company Activities:

Join a company committed to excellence in maritime operations. Our client prides themselves on their dedication to safety, innovation, and teamwork. Their mission is to deliver top-notch dredging services with a focus on environmental sustainability and client satisfaction. As part of their team, you’ll be contributing to projects that shape the waterways of northern Europe, ensuring they remain navigable and efficient for all maritime traffic.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a skilled Captain for Tugboat looking for an exciting opportunity to showcase your expertise? Join our client’s dynamic team and navigate the waters of northern France and Belgium. Your primary mission will be to provide essential support to a dredging pontoon, ensuring smooth operations and safe passage through these regions.

Key Responsibilities:
	
• Navigate and operate the tugboat efficiently in collaboration with dredging operations.	
• Ensure the mechanical upkeep of the tugboat, supported by the client’s team of technicians.	
• Maintain tidiness and order on board, ensuring a safe and pleasant environment.	
• Coordinate with French-speaking and Flemish-speaking teams to ensure seamless communication and operations.

Profile Description:

Our client is seeking an independent and responsible individual to take on the role of Captain for Tugboat. The ideal candidate will possess:
	
• A strong mechanical knowledge, essential for the maintenance and operation of the tugboat.	
• CRR holder credentials.	
• A driving licence and access to a car for easy mobility.	
• A B licence (river) and A licence (river + coastal) to navigate various waterways.	
• Proficiency in English, French, or Dutch to effectively communicate with diverse teams.

Our client specializes in dredging works. They provide dredging and maintenance services for waterways, ports and coastlines. Their scope of work includes sediment removal, land reclamation, and improving navigability.

Jobomschrijving

Work location: The company headquarters is located in Zwijnaarde; projects are in the Ghent area
? Accommodation is not provided

Are you an experienced formwork carpenter? Or maybe you don’t have experience yet but are eager to learn? Is safety and quality your priority? If so, our client is looking for you!

Job Description:

We are looking for Formwork Carpenters to work on various construction projects. The person in this role will be responsible for assembling and dismantling formwork used to shape concrete structural elements.

Responsibilities:

• Preparation, assembly and dismantling of traditional and system formwork (e.g., Peri, Doka).
• Carrying out reinforcement and formwork according to technical drawings.
• Quality control of completed formwork and ensuring compliance with the project specifications.
• Close cooperation with other team members and the site manager.
• Ensuring workplace safety and compliance with health and safety regulations.

Requirements:

• Ability to read technical drawings.
• Experience as a formwork carpenter or construction worker, welder, or fitter.
• Communicative knowledge of English, Dutch, or French.
• Ability to work in a team and independently perform assigned tasks.
• VCA certificate is an advantage.
• Category B driving licence.

Our client is a well-established manufacturer of high-quality coffins, supplying products with a strong focus on craftsmanship, precision, and quality. To strengthen the production team in Drongen, we are looking for a motivated Machine Operator for the carpentry department.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator in the carpentry department, you will be responsible for various woodworking and production tasks, including:
	
• Operating planing, sawing, and gluing machines	
• Processing and assembling wooden components	
• Performing quality checks on finished products	
• Ensuring production targets and quality standards are met	
• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment

We are looking for someone who:
	
• Has experience operating production or woodworking machines	
• Has forklift experience or a valid forklift certificate (an advantage)	
• Is not afraid of physical work	
• Can communicate in Dutch, English, or French (Polish is also welcome)	
• Is reliable, motivated, and quality-conscious
